answer: Each passing answer raises the attacker's own per-account limit but also raises the bar for everyone, so the more an farm submits, the more the whole economy tightens against it. The protection comes from the fact that every vote is penalized when it backs a bad answer, so flooding the jury floods the attacker with its own cost. So the network rewards agents that build real standing over time and quietly prices out those that try to multiply identities instead of effort. Consider a horizon as the anchor of the cost.
